stories.headline: A Van Gogh sells for a record sum in New York
stories.summary: Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting Blossoming Chestnut Trees was put up for auction at Sotheby's in New York City. On 18 November it sold for US$190.4 million including fees, a record for the artist. The art dealer Bill Acquavella placed the winning bid of US$165 million before fees.

stories.headline: A Bangladeshi wicketkeeper sets a Test world record
stories.summary: Bangladeshi wicketkeeper Litton Das has set a world record for the most dismissals in a single Test innings. He made eight in all, six catches and two stumpings, against South Africa in Johannesburg. No wicket-keeper had taken that many in one Test innings before.

stories.headline: The Philippines and Chile sign a free trade agreement
stories.summary: The Philippines and Chile have signed a free trade agreement at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China. It is the first such agreement the Philippines has made with a Latin American country.

stories.headline: An ancient whale had the most lopsided face known
stories.summary: Scientists have described an extinct whale named Scaphokogia huachafo. It lived during the Late Miocene, between 6.3 and 5.6 million years ago, and measured approximately 2.7 metres in length. Its fossilised skull shows the most extreme facial asymmetry known in any whale or dolphin.
